summary: {director} shows the council which fund will receive the money raised at municipal courses.
realLife: Portland directed the golf program to develop prices expected to finance a transfer to the parks general fund.
gates: The local government runs the recreation service and is considering or implementing a change to its fee.
inGame: The park fee series supplies the jurisdiction's change in the charge level. needs: the fee schedule, collecting fund and receiving fund.

turns.pulledBy: The higher schedule collects enough for the planned transfer.
turns.what: Finance staff bring the transfer to the council review.
turns.writesBack: The receiving fund records the amount transferred.

turns.pulledBy: The reduced schedule leaves less money for the transfer.
turns.what: The director presents the revised estimate.
turns.writesBack: The receiving fund's forecast shows the difference.
